topic: A stuck EVAP purge valve throws a check-engine light for a reason you'd never guess
negativePromptStanding: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Check engine light comes and goes, and you catch a faint fuel smell near the gas cap?
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a fuel filler door/gas cap area at a pump, slight haze/heat shimmer suggesting a faint vapor smell, static-mounted camera.

beats.narration: Idle stumbles a little, especially right after you fill up.
beats.visualPrompt: Low-angle shot of an idling engine bay, visible slight rpm flutter at idle; cut to a dashboard check-engine light illuminated amber, then fading.

beats.narration: One clue: a stuck EVAP purge valve. It controls fuel vapor flow into the engine.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: an EVAP purge solenoid valve on a workbench, hose fittings visible, slow push-in revealing an internal diaphragm cutaway diagram overlay-style shot.

beats.narration: Stuck open or closed, it can throw off your idle and trip that light.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on an OBD-II scan-tool screen showing an idle/RPM trace dipping and recovering, screen glow in a dim shop bay, tool mounted/clipped in frame.

beats.narration: Don't guess which part it is. A smoke test can help find the leak.
beats.visualPrompt: Rig-mounted smoke-test wand emitting visible smoke near an intake hose joint in a shop bay, soft background blur.

beats.narration: Worth checking before it fails emissions testing. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold. Logo/CTA composited in post, not AI-generated.
